There is no option to disable AutoRole either which is why I wanted to shed light on this situation. The module will ensure to set the player role to match their active spec. This will occur when the `LibSpec.RegisterGroup` callback occurs, or when combat ends and the `PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED` event fires. It is only an annoyance in situations the unit role does not match the active specialization role, combined with LFG group building. I hope the steps to reproduce shines more light on the specifics. ### Did this happen on PTR/Beta or the live version of WoW? Live ### What steps will reproduce the problem? Any character that can multi-role will be able to reproduce the same situation. 1. Activate a specialization that will not be used in the keystone run. _(For example Havoc/Damager)_ 2. Manually set the role to the intended role to be used in the keystone run. _(For example Vengeance/Tank)_ 3. Make a LFG group listing. 4. As people join, change, events causing `LibSpec` to fire updates via the registered callback, your role will be changed back to the role for the active specialization. 5. The people looking for a group will see that your group doesn't have the role that you intend to fulfill once the party is assembled. ### Attach a screenshot below to help describe your issue (Attach directly, do not link to other websites) ### What version of the addon are you using? ## Describe the problem


Currently, the nameplate feature is only applied to trash mobs in Bigwigs for dungeons.  There are a few rare boss abilities that are setup to have the nameplate option, but they're rare and are mostly all fixates. (There's like one boss cast and one or two boss frontal casts that I can think of in the current season with the nameplate option)  

So I assume the goal with Bigwigs having the nameplate cooldown feature is to cut down on unnecessary weakauras that make things easier for the player and less taxing on the game, but not having all boss casts included is something that would hold me back from fully swapping over.  If you made Bigwigs/Littlewigs, mostly speaking for dungeons here, have the ability to make any ability that is possible, so any ability that has a set cooldown, able to have a nameplate option, this would fill the role of any seasonal weakaura pack, but at the moment, having only trash casts work with the nameplate feature will probably cause people like myself to hold off.  I know having both a bar and nameplate for a given ability might sound redundant, but the option to choose is nice (especially because most ppl are mostly focused on nameplates), especially when it's already built into the addon for most other casts.

Basically I'm just asking for any cast that has a cooldown have the nameplate option, ie anything with a set cooldown/isn't triggered by a boss hp% or something besides a cooldown, have the nameplate option.

It would also be beneficial to simultaneously give all "categories" (so nameplate, sounds, bars, emphasize, messages, countdown, etc)"General full addon toggles," to be able to turn all of something off, and go back and just put the few on that you want, or reverse, toggling all of of a type on, and turning the few off, would be a lot more user friendly. I'm in charge of assigning raid CDs for my group and I would love to do this based on bigwigs-timers.
